about: Zeal Aqua Ltd is a Surat-based aquaculture and seafood company. It farms shrimp, supports satellite/contract farms, trades shrimp inputs, and processes and exports frozen seafood. Processing began in 2017. Products now include Vannamei and SPF Black Tiger shrimp, fish fillets and other value-added seafood. [1] [2]
